subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before merging this narrow probe-header fix, or explicitly accept the credential gap?
rationale: External PRs normally need after-fix real behavior proof, but the required Z.AI Coding Plan key is unavailable to the contributor and may require maintainer-supplied credentials or an explicit proof override.

options.title: Require or provide live proof
options.body: Merge only after the contributor or a maintainer adds redacted endpoint-detection logs, terminal output, or an artifact showing coding endpoint selection after the header change.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the linked issue's live before-fix proof plus this source-level patch and tests as sufficient for this narrow provider probe fix.

options.title: Pause for canonical selection
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers choose among the open duplicate candidate PRs for the same linked issue.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live proof
recommendation.body: Merge only after the contributor or a maintainer adds redacted endpoint-detection logs, terminal output, or an artifact showing coding endpoint selection after the header change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest feature-history owner for the Z.AI endpoint auto-detection behavior and can decide whether the live-proof gap is acceptable.
